name: AccessDoor – Smart Admin Login & URL Control
author: IT Path Solutions

sections.description:
AccessDoor – Smart Admin Login & URL Control plugin allows site administrators to change the default WordPress admin login URL and assign custom login slugs for different user roles. Protect your site by blocking or redirecting access to wp-login.php.
Update admin usernames and email addresses instantly without confirmation emails and customize the WordPress login screen design.

Key Features

Login URL Management

  • Change the default WordPress admin login URL
  • Optional role-based login URLs (Admin, Editor, Shop Manager, etc.)
  • Automatic redirection from default login endpoints to custom URLs
  • Safe fallback mechanism to prevent lockouts

Admin Username Management

  • Change administrator usernames securely
  • Prevent use of common or predictable admin usernames
  • No database corruption or user data loss

Email Management

  • Change user emails securely
  • Change admin emails
  • Prevent use of common or predictable email addresses

Login Page Customization

  • Change login page background image or color
  • Replace WordPress logo with your own branding
  • Customize layout and visual appearance of the login screen
  • Lightweight and compatible with most themes

Security Enhancements

  • Reduces exposure to automated login attacks
  • Limits access to login pages based on configuration
  • Clean logout handling with proper session cleanup

Important Notes

  • This plugin does not permanently disable default WordPress login functionality.
  • A fallback access method is always available to avoid accidental lockouts.
  • Administrators should keep recovery access details safe.
sections.installation:
1. Upload accessdoor-smart-admin-login-url-control plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the AccessDoor settings page from your WordPress admin dashboard to configure login options.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin lock me out of my site?

No. The plugin includes a built-in fallback mechanism to ensure administrators can always regain access.

Does this plugin completely disable wp-login.php?

No. Default login endpoints are redirected based on your settings but not permanently blocked.

Can I customize the login page design?

Yes. You can change the background, logo, and basic layout of the login page.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. It supports WooCommerce roles such as Shop Manager and Customer.
